LanguageData.MiliraXian_BackStoryChild_Zhaoli_BS1.des: Among the six branches evolved from "Ji", she was once the most loyal corpse-collector of "Death". Her great blade had been stained by the blood of countless traitors and enemies. Even while young, her name made many tremble. Long immersion in blood left her with few rivals on the path of death.
LanguageData.MiliraXian_BackStoryAdult_Zhaoli_BS1.des: For reasons unknown, she eventually chose to betray the path of "Death" and walk farther along the journey of "Life". Mastering the karma of life and death, she became a physician. She constantly refines her medical skill, yet has never forgotten that life and death are separated by only one boundary.
